order.invite_link_why: Why do I need an invite link? An invite link is needed so that new subscribers can join your channel/chat. Without it, ad display is not possible.
order.invite_link_how: How to create an invite link? 1. Open your channel/chat settings 2. Go to "Invite links" section 3. Create a new link or copy an existing one 4. Send the link to the bot
order.troubleshoot: Why is my order not working? Possible reasons: • Order is under moderation • Insufficient balance • Channel is blocked • Bot is not an admin • Price per subscriber is too low Try: 1. Check your balance 2. Increase the price 3. Add the bot as admin 4. Contact support
